nrr:aiUseDeclaration.statement: The article makes no statement about the use of generative AI in writing; machine-learning classifiers are part of the method and are recorded as software, not as authors.

gelCompositions: SiO2 : x Al2O3 : y Na2O : z R(OH) : 43.3 H2O
SiO2 : w Al2O3 : x K2O : y R(OH) : z RI : 40 H2O
nrr:applicabilityConditions.inorganicCations: none for the STF and first IFR series; Na+ up to 0.18 Na2O and K+ up to 0.29 K2O per SiO2 for the second IFR series
nrr:applicabilityConditions.medium: synthesis in hydroxide media, without fluoride
nrr:applicabilityConditions.modelAssumptions: framework aluminium as the only charge compensation (no silanol defects), intact OSDA, no solvent or counter-cation effects, thermodynamic ranking by synthesis energy without nucleation kinetics
nrr:applicabilityConditions.note: conclusions are bounded to hydroxide media; the authors note that both frameworks may remain accessible in fluoride or pure-silica systems
nrr:applicabilityConditions.osdasScreened: more than 1000 known OSDAs from OSDB and over 7000 designed OSDAs
nrr:applicabilityConditions.productIdentification: powder X-ray diffraction (SI Figures S10, S12, S14); no detection limit for a minority crystalline phase is stated
nrr:applicabilityConditions.siAlRange: pure silica to Si/Al 10 (Al2O3 per SiO2 from 0 to 0.05)

targets.IFR: large-pore zeolite, undulating 12-ring channels about 6.2 x 7.2 A; obtained as an aluminosilicate only with benzylquinuclidinium cations, usually in fluoride media
targets.STF: one-dimensional medium-pore zeolite, 10-ring channels about 5.4 x 5.7 A; never obtained as an aluminosilicate

nrr:confidence.basis: no positive-control synthesis; the OSDA survived, so the absence of IFR is not explained by degradation

nrr:cost.note: 14 phase determinations over 14 gel compositions; done at POSTECH

@graph.nrr:outcomeSummary: Fourteen gel compositions with Si/Al 10 to 100, with or without Na+ or K+, at 150 to 175 °C for 7 to 21 days gave amorphous solids, mordenite, ZSM-12 (MTW, ranked 13th in the prediction) or dense phases; never IFR.
nrr:provenanceNotes: Table 2 (image in the XML) reports QG001780m2 as 'amorphous (Table S22) and amorphous + MTW (Table S21)'; Table S21 also lists MOR and dense phases and Table S22 lists MOR and a dense phase, which Table 2 and the Discussion do not mention
@graph.nrr:successCriteria: A powder X-ray diffraction pattern matching IFR.
